tara: quick flag 1: we saw a small regression in embeddings in prod last hour (spike in 5xxs when load spikes). I have a hotpatch ready: model-embed v2.3.2-hotpatch. Can we do an express cut in the 01:20-01:30 UTC window?

sam: what's the blast radius? canary or full?

tara: small change: kvcache TTL tweak + eviction lock. Staging :smoke: passed. Prefer skipping canary due to non-deterministic parity issue that hides in 10% lanes. Plan is 3-step roll (10/60/100) with tight monitors.

nora: PM ack, will draft the external note. Tara pls paste the 1-liner and the exact deploy command.

tara: deploy command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.2-hotpatch --no-canary --note "hotfix: kvcache eviction race"`

ops_oncall: I'm on watch. Rollback criteria: embed_error_rate >1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency +150ms vs baseline. Also watch tokenization errors (we saw a couple).

matt: I'll open an emergency monitoring dashboard and hook pager thresholds.

deploybot: Deploybot: deploy slot open at 01:22 UTC. To execute run the pinned command. Confirmers required: @nora @ops_oncall.

nora: Confirmed. Approving expedited deploy for the 01:22 slot.

releasebot: Releasebot: please remember to add changelog entry.

tara: changelog blurb: "v2.3.2-hotpatch: Fix kvcache eviction race that caused intermittent embedding failures under burst. Backported lock and TTL adjustments."

sam: quick sanity preflight: `http POST https://internal/api/embed-check version=v2.3.2-hotpatch samples=100`

matt: preflight returned 0/100 errors, latency 110ms p95 (baseline 115ms)

tara: kicking off at 01:22 now. @deploybot please run pin.

deploybot: Started rollout at 01:22 UTC. Steps: 10% -> 60% -> 100%. Monitors: embed_error_rate, p95_latency, token_errors. Live: https://deploys.internal/1766001234

ops_oncall: 10% step good. No spike. p95 down slightly.

matt: 60% step in progress. small blip in token_errors at one host, autoscaler cycled it. Investigating.

nora: are we seeing customer impact? any externally visible errors?

matt: no external errors, internal retries handled it. continuing.

deploybot: 100% complete at 01:26 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy (5m): embed_error_rate = 0.4%, p95 latency = 118ms. token_errors normalized. No rollback needed.

nora: published external note to #customers and updated changelog.

tara: thanks all. assigning follow-up to a brief incident doc in next 24h to capture root cause and regression test.

sam: nice quick turnaround. :rocket:
